name: upstream
trusted: project type and module resolution and source snapshots
unmodified standard Number/Math/Object/Array builtins and prototypes
solver-model heap graphs replayed with shared identities and a write-monitoring Proxy membrane
solver-model predicate tables replayed as pure total JavaScript functions using Object.is

assumptions.name: fn
assumptions.domain: Pure total predicates from every binary64 number to a present boolean: includes NaN, infinities, signed zeros and subnormals; excludes undefined, effects, exceptions and mutable captures. NaN payloads are not distinguished; function identity, properties and this are unsupported.

assumptions.name: list
assumptions.domain: Dense ordinary arrays, standard prototypes, no extra properties; every native array length is included. References may be shared across parameters and fields.
